items.summary_en: A Spanish streamer named Ibai Llanos shared the names of some Chilean towns with his viewers. One town in the Biobío region stood out for its unusual name. The clip made people in Chile laugh and talk about their local places.

items.raw_excerpt: 交通部觀光局配合二○二○年脊梁山脈旅遊年，遴選出全台「小鎮二．○」卅個經典小鎮，預計推動下一波小鎮漫遊熱潮，花蓮吉安及富里鄉雙雙入選，春節將至，吉安花海、富里稻草藝術節接續登場，民眾除可從自吉安楓林步道俯瞰美翻的花蓮平原及海岸山脈北側，還能到富里與六米高銀背大猩猩合影，漫遊小鎮、體驗地方風情。吉安楓林步道 遠眺太平洋
items.summary_en: Taiwan's tourism bureau chose 30 classic small towns for its Small Town 2.0 tourism year. Hualien's Jian and Fuli townships both made the list. Visitors can enjoy Jian's flower fields and Fuli's straw art festival.
items.summary_ko: 대만 관광국이 '소도시 2.0' 관광의 해를 맞아 전국의 클래식 소도시 30곳을 선정했다. 화롄의 지안과 푸리 향이 나란히 이름을 올렸다. 관광객은 지안의 꽃밭과 푸리의 짚 예술 축제를 즐길 수 있다.
items.title_en: Taiwan Picks 30 Classic Small Towns for Spring Travel

items.summary_en: The art critic Vittorio Sgarbi keeps talking about the same things again and again. A famous Italian saying notes that the violinist Paganini never repeated himself. This article plays on that contrast.

items.title_en: Paganini did not repeat. Sgarbi does
